versions.changelog:
basis-arb v1.0.0 — Initial release

- Provides a directional spot–perp basis strategy template for Freqtrade (long-perp leg only).
- Reads spot-perp basis and funding rate to generate a long-perp entry when both flip negative (basis < 0 and funding < 0).
- Requires both spot and perp pairs (e.g., on Hyperliquid); does not run actual two-leg hedged arb.
- Does not place trades unless spot OHLCV data is available; current backtest engines may result in zero trades.
- Shipped as a teachable example for basis-driven directional entries, not as a market-neutral arbitrage bot.
